experiences.title: 向警察报案
experiences.summary: 在“向警察报案”中练习“询问下一步怎么办”相关的英语交流。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d like to report a theft. My wallet was stolen earlier today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report a theft. My wallet was stolen earlier today.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Someone stole my phone while I was on the subway.

feedback.naturalExpression: Someone stole my phone while I was on the subway.
feedback.explanation: 用“while”说明手机被偷时自己在哪里，给事件提供明确背景。

choices.text: I think my bag was taken while I was sitting in a café.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think my bag was taken while I was sitting in a café.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m not sure exactly when it happened, but my wallet is missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure exactly when it happened, but my wallet is missing.
feedback.explanation: “is missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: I want to report that someone stole my things.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report a theft. My wallet was stolen earlier today.
feedback.explanation: “my things”太泛；报出钱包或手机等具体物品，更方便记录和寻找。

turns.text: When did you first notice it was missing?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认时间或时长，你会怎样补充信息？

choices.text: At around three this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: At around three this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I noticed it right after I got off the train.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed it right after I got off the train.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: About twenty minutes after I left the café.

feedback.naturalExpression: About twenty minutes after I left the café.
feedback.explanation: 以离开咖啡馆为参照给出大致时间，便于还原遗失经过。

choices.text: I’m not sure, but it must have happened sometime between two and three.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure, but it must have happened sometime between two and three.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.prompt: 对方在确认位置或去向，你会怎样说清楚地点？

choices.text: I was on a crowded train.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was on a crowded train.
feedback.explanation: “crowded train”说明当时在拥挤的车厢内，补充可能影响观察的环境。

choices.text: I was walking through the market.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was walking through the market.
feedback.explanation: 过去进行时说明当时正在做什么，适合描述事情发生前后的经过。

choices.text: I stopped at a café near the station.

feedback.naturalExpression: I stopped at a café near the station.
feedback.explanation: 提供停留过的具体地点，帮助缩小寻找或核查范围。

choices.text: I went straight from the station to my hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I went straight from the station to my hotel.
feedback.explanation: “from … to …”把起止时间或范围一起说清，适合确认完整安排。

turns.text: Did you actually see anyone take it?

turns.prompt: 关于「向警察报案」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: No, I didn’t notice anything at the time.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I didn’t notice anything at the time.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: No, I only realized it was gone later.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I only realized it was gone later.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I felt someone bump into me, but I didn’t see them take anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: I felt someone bump into me, but I didn’t see them take anything.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: Yes. I saw someone grab my bag and run away.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I saw someone grab my bag and run away.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

scenarios.title: B｜描述嫌疑人
scenarios.setting: 在“向警察报案”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“描述嫌疑人”。

turns.text: Did you see the person clearly?

turns.prompt: 关于「向警察报案」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Not very clearly. Everything happened really fast.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not very clearly. Everything happened really fast.
feedback.explanation: 承认没看清，并解释事情发生太快，避免把不确定的目击信息说得过满。

choices.text: Yes, I got a pretty good look at them.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I got a pretty good look at them.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I saw them for a few seconds before they ran away.

feedback.naturalExpression: I saw them for a few seconds before they ran away.
feedback.explanation: “a few seconds”表示几秒，能简短说明连接或反应维持了多久。

choices.text: I didn’t see their face, but I remember what they were wearing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t see their face, but I remember what they were wearing.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

turns.prompt: 对方需要辨认物品，你会怎样描述特征？

choices.text: He was fairly tall, with short dark hair.

feedback.naturalExpression: He was fairly tall, with short dark hair.
feedback.explanation: 用身高和发型提供可观察的特征，便于对方辨认所描述的人。

choices.text: She looked quite young and had long brown hair.

feedback.naturalExpression: She looked quite young and had long brown hair.
feedback.explanation: “looked quite young”说明是外观印象，没有把估计年龄说成确定事实。

choices.text: I couldn’t see their face clearly because they were wearing a hood.

feedback.naturalExpression: I couldn’t see their face clearly because they were wearing a hood.
feedback.explanation: 补充原因或目的，让对方明白提出这个想法的依据。

choices.text: I’m not sure about their age, but they were wearing a gray jacket and dark pants.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure about their age, but they were wearing a gray jacket and dark pants.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: He was high and had black hairs.

feedback.naturalExpression: He was fairly tall, with short dark hair.
feedback.explanation: 身高用“tall”，不是“high”；头发统称“hair”，这里不加 -s。

turns.prompt: 对方在确认你的选择，你会怎样说明偏好或补充需求？

choices.text: He was carrying a black backpack.

feedback.naturalExpression: He was carrying a black backpack.
feedback.explanation: 描述当时携带的背包，比猜测身份更有助于现场辨认。

choices.text: She was wearing glasses.

feedback.naturalExpression: She was wearing glasses.
feedback.explanation: “was wearing glasses”说明事发时戴眼镜，是简洁的外观描述。

choices.text: I think he had a tattoo on his right arm.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think he had a tattoo on his right arm.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: That’s about all I can remember.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s about all I can remember.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m afraid I don’t remember anything else.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I don’t remember anything else.
feedback.explanation: “I don't remember”表达自己没有印象，并不直接断言这件事从未发生。

turns.prompt: 你想说明嫌疑人离开的方向，会怎么说？

choices.text: They ran toward the station.

feedback.naturalExpression: They ran toward the station.
feedback.explanation: “toward”说明移动方向，目击描述中比笼统说走了更有用。

choices.text: I think they went down this street and turned right.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think they went down this street and turned right.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m sorry, I didn’t see where they went.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, I didn’t see where they went.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

scenarios.title: C｜询问下一步怎么办
scenarios.setting: 在“向警察报案”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问下一步怎么办”。

turns.text: All right. I’ve taken down the details of your report.

turns.prompt: 你想确认报案后自己还需要做什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: What should I do next?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do next?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Is there anything else you need from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you need from me?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Will I get a copy of the police report?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a copy of the police report?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is there a report number I should keep?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a report number I should keep?
feedback.explanation: “report number”指报告或报案编号，便于后续联系时定位记录。

choices.text: What should I do in the next?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do next?
feedback.explanation: “next”在这里可直接作副词，说“What should I do next?”，不加“in the”。

turns.text: We’ll give you a reference number for the report. Keep it in case you need it for insurance or replacing your documents.

turns.prompt: 你想确认位置或前往的路线，会怎么问？

choices.text: How can I get a copy of the report?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I get a copy of the report?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Who should I contact if I remember something else later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who should I contact if I remember something else later?
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: Will you contact me if there’s any update?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you contact me if there’s any update?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Do I need to come back to the station again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to come back to the station again?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

turns.text: You can contact us using the number on this form.

turns.prompt: 你想了解是否还需联系银行或使馆处理失窃物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Should I contact my bank now as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Should I contact my bank now as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: My passport was stolen too. Do I need this report when I contact my embassy?

feedback.naturalExpression: My passport was stolen too. Do I need this report when I contact my embassy?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is there anything else you recommend I do right away?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you recommend I do right away?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

turns.text: Make sure you cancel any stolen cards and secure any accounts that may be affected.

turns.prompt: 关于「向警察报案」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll do that right away. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll do that right away. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll keep the report number with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll keep the report number with me.
feedback.explanation: “report number”指报告或报案编号，便于后续联系时定位记录。
